metric_en: Maximum relative gm error on 78 retained transfer-grid probes
metric_zh: 原转移曲线78个探针点的最大gm相对误差
reference_en: 75-digit Decimal current with independent centered derivative h=1e-16 V; 26 gate points at each of -40/25/125 C.
reference_zh: 75位Decimal电流与独立中心差分h=1e-16V；三个温度各26个栅压点。
limits_en: Accuracy of the existing interpolation's derivative only; no device/PDK accuracy gain or added physics.
limits_zh: 仅提升既有插值公式的导数计算精度，不代表器件/PDK准确度或新增物理机制。
reference_resolution_en: Practical binary64 comparison guard = 64*epsilon*characteristic_scale*conditioning_factor; not a rigorous error bound or physical tolerance. Unit relative derivative scale; audited transfer probes avoid near-cancelling forward/reverse terms.
reference_resolution_zh: 实用双精度比较保护量=64×机器epsilon×特征尺度×条件因子；不是严格误差界或物理容差。单位相对导数尺度；审计的转移探针点不涉及正反项近相消。

metric_en: Maximum relative charge error in a near-zero numerical stress test
metric_zh: 近零电压数值压力测试的最大电荷相对误差
reference_en: 70-digit Decimal evaluation of the original charge equation; 294 probes, |Vj|=1e-18 to 1e-6 V, both polarities and three temperatures.
reference_zh: 原电荷方程的70位Decimal参考；294个探针点，|Vj|=1e-18至1e-6V，正负两种极性及三个温度。
limits_en: Stress-test range is explicitly separate from the original plotted CV sweep; eliminates cancellation, not an across-the-board measured capacitance improvement.
limits_zh: 压力测试电压范围与原绘制的CV扫描明确分开；消除数值相消，不表示全部实测电容精度提高。
reference_resolution_en: Practical binary64 comparison guard = 64*epsilon*characteristic_scale*conditioning_factor; not a rigorous error bound or physical tolerance. Unit relative charge scale; rationalized near-zero denominator remains approximately two.
reference_resolution_zh: 实用双精度比较保护量=64×机器epsilon×特征尺度×条件因子；不是严格误差界或物理容差。单位相对电荷尺度；有理化后近零分母约为2。

reference_zh: Ebers-Moll三端电流守恒精确关系：Ic+Ib+Ie=0。
limits_en: Existing closed-form expm1 evaluation is retained; residual is at floating-point scale. No numerical improvement percentage is assigned.
limits_zh: 保留既有expm1解析计算；残差已在浮点精度量级，不赋予数值提升百分比。
reference_resolution_en: Practical binary64 comparison guard = 64*epsilon*characteristic_scale*conditioning_factor; not a rigorous error bound or physical tolerance. Terminal-current conservation is normalized by the largest terminal current.
reference_resolution_zh: 实用双精度比较保护量=64×机器epsilon×特征尺度×条件因子；不是严格误差界或物理容差。端口电流守恒残差按最大端口电流归一化。

metric_en: Asymptotic relative sampling SE of estimated Gaussian pair sigma
metric_zh: 高斯配对标准差估计的渐近相对抽样标准误
reference_en: Delta-method approximation SE(s)/sigma≈1/sqrt(2(N-1)); fourfold samples. This is a sampling-uncertainty estimate, not a deterministic error.
reference_zh: Delta方法近似SE(s)/sigma≈1/sqrt(2(N-1))；样本量增至四倍。此为抽样不确定度估计，不是确定性误差。
limits_en: Reported separately from numerical accuracy. A single realized sigma estimate may move either direction; no foundry statistics or yield improvement.
limits_zh: 与数值准确度分开报告；单次标准差估计可能向任一方向变化，不代表工艺统计或良率改善。
reference_resolution_en: Asymptotic Gaussian sampling-SE formula for the declared sample counts; no deterministic numerical-error floor applies. Not a confidence interval for the realized sample sigma.
reference_resolution_zh: 针对声明样本量的渐近高斯抽样标准误公式；不适用确定性数值误差下限，也不是实得样本标准差的置信区间。

metric_zh: 理想尾电流最大相对残差
reference_en: Exact tail condition I1+I2=100 uA on all 1203 saved bias points.
reference_zh: 1203个保存偏置点满足精确尾电流条件I1+I2=100μA。
limits_en: 80 bisection steps already reach double-precision resolution; retained unchanged, no fabricated 10% gain.
limits_zh: 80次二分已达到双精度分辨率，保持不变，不虚构10%提升。
reference_resolution_en: Practical binary64 comparison guard = 64*epsilon*characteristic_scale*conditioning_factor; not a rigorous error bound or physical tolerance. Tail-current residual is normalized by the largest terminal current, 100 uA.
reference_resolution_zh: 实用双精度比较保护量=64×机器epsilon×特征尺度×条件因子；不是严格误差界或物理容差。尾电流残差按最大端口电流100μA归一化。

metric_en: Maximum reference-voltage error against simplified analytic sum
metric_zh: 相对简化解析合成式的最大基准电压误差
limits_en: Existing analytic evaluation is already at floating-point floor; temperature curvature and physical assumptions are unchanged.
limits_zh: 原解析计算已处于浮点精度下限，温度曲率及物理假设不变。
reference_resolution_en: Practical binary64 comparison guard = 64*epsilon*characteristic_scale*conditioning_factor; not a rigorous error bound or physical tolerance. Maximum saved reference voltage sets the voltage scale.
reference_resolution_zh: 实用双精度比较保护量=64×机器epsilon×特征尺度×条件因子；不是严格误差界或物理容差。以保存的最大基准电压作为电压尺度。

metric_en: Maximum RMS noise integration error across six band integrals
metric_zh: 六个带内积分的最大噪声均方根误差
reference_en: 70-digit evaluation of elementary PSD antiderivatives over 1 Hz–1 MHz; both spectra and all three temperatures.
reference_zh: 1Hz至1MHz PSD初等原函数的70位参考；两个频谱与三个温度。
limits_en: Saved PSD grid is unchanged; metric integration is analytic. No transistor noise, aliasing or measured amplifier calibration is added.
limits_zh: 保存的PSD网格不变，指标积分改为解析式；未增加晶体管噪声、混叠或实测放大器校准。
reference_resolution_en: Practical binary64 comparison guard = 64*epsilon*characteristic_scale*conditioning_factor; not a rigorous error bound or physical tolerance. Largest RMS value among the six positive band integrals sets the voltage scale.
reference_resolution_zh: 实用双精度比较保护量=64×机器epsilon×特征尺度×条件因子；不是严格误差界或物理容差。以六个正值带内积分中的最大均方根电压作为尺度。

metric_en: Maximum absolute DNL of the ideal SAR
reference_en: Ideal binary CDAC transition widths equal one LSB, hence DNL=0.
reference_zh: 理想二进制CDAC转换码宽为一个LSB，因此DNL=0。
limits_en: Sequential-decision search and coherent FFT retained. Existing 60-step thresholds are at machine precision; no ENOB/physical accuracy gain is asserted.
limits_zh: 保留逐次判决搜索与相干FFT，原60次边界搜索已达机器精度；不声称ENOB或实物准确度提升。
reference_resolution_en: Practical binary64 comparison guard = 64*epsilon*characteristic_scale*conditioning_factor; not a rigorous error bound or physical tolerance. Full-scale binary64 voltage rounding converts to 1024 LSB units for a 10-bit ADC.
reference_resolution_zh: 实用双精度比较保护量=64×机器epsilon×特征尺度×条件因子；不是严格误差界或物理容差。10位ADC满量程双精度电压舍入换算为1024LSB尺度。

metric_zh: 最大单位增益交越频率误差
reference_en: 70-digit positive root of the exact |L(jw)|=1 quadratic; three temperatures. Transients separately use exact 2x2 propagation.
reference_zh: 精确|L(jw)|=1二次方程正根的70位参考，三个温度；瞬态另采用精确2×2传播。
limits_en: Removes interpolation/ODE discretization for the retained linear loop; no dropout, current limit, transistor network or measured phase-margin validation.
limits_zh: 消除既有线性环路的插值及ODE离散误差；未加入压差、限流、晶体管网络或实测相位裕度验证。
reference_resolution_en: Practical binary64 comparison guard = 64*epsilon*characteristic_scale*conditioning_factor; not a rigorous error bound or physical tolerance. Largest unity-crossing frequency sets the scale; the stable positive root is away from the DC-gain-one singular boundary.
reference_resolution_zh: 实用双精度比较保护量=64×机器epsilon×特征尺度×条件因子；不是严格误差界或物理容差。以最大交越频率作为尺度；稳定正根远离直流增益为1的奇异边界。

metric_en: Maximum sampled phase-step error over three damping ratios
metric_zh: 三种阻尼比的最大采样相位阶跃误差
reference_en: 75-digit matrix-exponential Taylor scaling/squaring, 101 times per damping ratio; independent of the new Cayley-Hamilton implementation.
reference_zh: 75位矩阵指数Taylor缩放平方法，每阻尼比101个时刻；独立于新版Cayley-Hamilton实现。
limits_en: Canonical phase-domain response only. PSD quadrature also refined without enlarging saved traces; no transistor VCO, cycle-slip or measured-jitter accuracy claim.
limits_zh: 仅典型相位域响应；PSD积分也细化且不扩大保存曲线，未增加晶体管VCO、周跳或实测抖动准确度。
reference_resolution_en: Practical binary64 comparison guard = 64*epsilon*characteristic_scale*conditioning_factor; not a rigorous error bound or physical tolerance. Maximum saved phase magnitude covers step and overshoot.
reference_resolution_zh: 实用双精度比较保护量=64×机器epsilon×特征尺度×条件因子；不是严格误差界或物理容差。最大保存相位幅度覆盖阶跃与过冲。

metric_en: Maximum periodic mean-output-voltage error across 18 cases
metric_zh: 18个工况的最大周期平均输出电压误差
reference_en: Independent periodic volt-second/charge balance: <Vout>=Vin*D/(1+(Rsw+RL)/Rload)=12 V for the unchanged duty law.
reference_zh: 独立周期伏秒及电荷平衡：<Vout>=Vin*D/(1+(Rsw+RL)/Rload)=12V，沿用原占空比公式。
limits_en: Exact affine propagation and phasewise Gauss integration improve the reduced conduction-only solution. Saved ripple extrema remain sampled; no switching-loss/real-device accuracy improvement.
limits_zh: 精确仿射传播与分段Gauss积分改进仅含导通损耗的简化解；纹波极值仍按保存点取样，不代表开关损耗或实物精度提升。
reference_resolution_en: Practical binary64 comparison guard = 64*epsilon*characteristic_scale*conditioning_factor; not a rigorous error bound or physical tolerance. 12 V output scale multiplied by maximum 2-norm condition number of I-exp(A*T), after scaling states as i/1 A and v/12 V.
reference_resolution_zh: 实用双精度比较保护量=64×机器epsilon×特征尺度×条件因子；不是严格误差界或物理容差。12V输出尺度乘以I-exp(A*T)的最大2范数条件数，状态先归一化为i/1A及v/12V。
